label: Diagram 5.2
caption: Diagram 5.2 Junction of compartment wall with roof | Cavities
description:
This is a section drawing titled "Diagram 5.2 Junction of compartment wall with roof", printed on a green banner along the bottom edge. The top of the image is cut off, showing only the lower part of a roof structure formed by lines and rectangular panels. Below this, on the left, is the label "c. ANY BUILDING OR COMPARTMENT".

The section shows a vertical grey rectangle labelled "Wall" rising through a roof line. On the right the roof line is horizontal and labelled "Roof covering"; on the left it slopes downwards and is also labelled "Roof covering". Two vertical dimension arrows, each labelled "At least 375mm", mark the height of the wall above the roof covering on each side.

To the right of the drawing is a block of running text reading: "The wall should be extended up through the roof for a height of at least 375mm above the top surface of the adjoining roof covering. Where there is a height difference of at least 375 mm between two roofs or where the roof coverings on either side of the wall are B ROOF (t4) rated, the height of the upstand/parapet wall above the highest roof may be reduced to 200mm."

notes: The description says "Two vertical dimension arrows", but the left-hand dimension is drawn obliquely, running diagonally from the top of the wall down to the sloping roof covering; only the right-hand dimension is vertical.
